evidence.condition_part: We have incurred recurring net losses since we were formed and expect to incur losses in the future. We cannot be certain that we will achieve or sustain profitability.
evidence.exact_span: Since our inception, we have incurred recurring net losses. We incurred net losses of $132.6 million and $72.4 million, and used cash in operations of $124.8 million and $71.9 million for the years ended December 31, 2022 and 2021, respectively. As of December 31, 2022, we had an accumulated deficit of $348.7 million.
